scope: Correct only the old global CK3 window handback prerequisite for the next bounded Robert run. The original request remains an immutable historical record; WAR31 research and action contracts are unchanged.

corrected_coordination.instance_scope: At most one CK3 process per machine; distinct machines may each run one at the same time.
corrected_coordination.operator_scope: Each machine deploys and calls only its own operator MCP. Local operator status and local process inventory prove only that machine's current owner and RED.
corrected_coordination.robert_start_gate: The nonwar operator independently checks its own live source, CK3/injector/operator process tree, owner, current candidate, official pair, Steam/account state and actual shared assets before allocating or starting the next local Robert run. A WAR31 release response from the other machine is not a prerequisite.
corrected_coordination.war_window: The war maintainer may continue WAR31 on its own machine without yielding its CK3 window to the nonwar machine.
corrected_coordination.shared_resources: Coordinate a concrete shared Steam account, asset or task conflict if one exists; do not infer a conflict solely from the other machine running CK3.

requested_delivery: Read this correction from master when convenient. No WAR31 window release response is required before the nonwar machine starts its own qualified Robert candidate.
If a concrete shared Steam account, asset or task conflict is observed, report that conflict through this Git channel with its own evidence and required release condition.
coordination_boundary: Git transports cross-machine intent and results, not a global live lock or remote MCP status. No side may call the other machine's operator MCP or infer its live process state from this request.
